scope: extraction bookkeeping, artifact storage, and checking; the step definition, the counting, the corpus, the strata, and the hypotheses are unchanged
change: The first run's extractor grouped tactic nodes by declaration across a whole command, while node indices are per command: the companion declarations of one command (derived instances, @[ext] companions, every `example` of a file) shared one index space. Of 3,992 extracted records, 4 had parent indices outside their own node list (instLawfulBEqLink, instLawfulBEqEdge, instLawfulBEqWaitingCell, UnificationMarking.ext_iff) and the three examples of ProofNetIR.LeanPropSchemaCorpus were merged into one record; the counter failed on the first malformed record and no count, summary, or report was produced. The extractor now splits the nodes of each command per declaration and re-indexes them (a parent outside the declaration becomes none), names private declarations by their user-facing name, and suffixes a name repeated within a file with the line of its first node; the counter rejects a record whose indices or parents are out of range; the extraction is stored as extraction.jsonl.gz (65 MB uncompressed) and hashed decompressed; --check-committed keys the re-extracted sample by (module, declaration) and compares node shapes, since goal names are fresh per elaboration and the committed records never had the `steps` field the check referenced; the runner takes the expected implementation hashes from the latest amendment.
